reasoning: Bucket: 4-way SRP flop, hero BB closing action facing bettor + 2 cold-callers on T64r rainbow with AdJh (no pair, no draw, two overcards on a paired-Ten dry board). Per-villain chains: UTG opened 2.5bb then small-bet ~22% pot into 3 villains; multiway small-bet skews to a balanced range-merge — value Tx (AT, KTs, QTs, JTs), overpairs JJ-AA, sets, plus AK/AQ/KQ that bet small to cheaply realize equity 4-way. Critically UTG kept his Tx + overpairs which crush hero. HJ cold-called preflop (capped, no QQ+/AK) and flat-called the c-bet MW — his continuing composition is heavy in Tx (KTs, QTs, JTs, T9s, ATs), middle pairs 77-99 that beat hero, and a sprinkle of OESD/gutshot draws (76s, 87s); roughly 55%+ pair-or-better. CO flatted behind HJ's flat — most range-capped of the three, biased toward suited Tx, middle pairs, and connectors that play well MW IP; his call-after-call further skews to made hands and live draws. Combined continuing field: ~65% of villain combos contain a Ten, a pair >= 77, or a set/two-pair. Hero's range/hand tension: AJo is bottom-30% of BB's flatting range on T64r — BB's range hits this board fine (Tx, sets, connectors), but THIS specific hand has 6 dirty outs (J pairs into KQ-broadway draws and KJ/QJ/JTs dominators; A pairs into AT and AK that crushes). No flush draw (rainbow), no straight draw (AJ doesn't connect on T64). MW equity-realization factor for 4-way ≈ 0.75; hero's raw ~18-22% equity vs the combined narrowed range realizes closer to 13-16%, barely matching the ~13% pot odds with zero margin. Multiway position dynamics: squeeze-pressure-from-behind is NIL since hero closes this street, BUT hero is OOP for all subsequent streets vs all 3 villains — closing-action benefit is single-street only, and OOP-3-deep realization is catastrophic. Every turn forces hero to act first into a field that already declared continuing strength; check-folding most turns wastes the call, and check-calling with overcards-only into MW barrels is dominated. Reverse-implied odds bite hard: when hero spikes A or J on the turn, multiple villain combos (AT, KT, JT, sets, two-pair) have hero crushed and extract chips. Pot-cascade trajectory: this pot will not stay 4-way to river, but the streets where it collapses are exactly where hero's no-pair-no-draw bleeds most. Action: FOLD. RAISE is dominated (no equity, no fold equity vs 3 declared-continuing villains, AJ unblocks bluffs and blocks zero value). CALL is the tempting losing alternative — pot odds invite it but the MW realization haircut plus OOP-3-deep negative realization plus reverse-implied odds make this a textbook multiway overfold spot for unpaired non-connecting broadway.
key_multiway_driver: OOP-3-deep negative realization plus 0.75 4-way realization factor turn AJ-no-draw into a fold despite tempting pot odds; closing-action benefit is single-street only and does not rescue the hand
